title: AI Runs Into Its Next Big Obstacle: Insurance
script:
Artificial intelligence companies now face a major hurdle securing proper insurance policies.
Insurers struggle to evaluate the unique risks tied to complex machine learning models.
Carriers worry about unpredictable software failures causing expensive damages for clients.
Developers face higher premiums and strict coverage limits across the market.
Companies must prove extensive safety testing before getting coverage signed.
Can insurance companies keep up with rapidly changing technology?
